title: Watch run
description: data of: ty watch-run --once --json (runwatch.py). What was worth saying about the imaging run, and whether it has ended. Without --once the command runs until the run ends and prints its lines as they come.

said.description: Each change worth acting on: frames stopped, none kept, the share kept halved, the stars dimmed or came back, the run ended. Empty while all is well.
